title: Quinoa Pilaf with Cranberries and Almonds
blurb: Fluffy quinoa cooked with onions and finished with toasted almonds and sweet cranberries. A light side dish or simple main.
steps: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly in a fine sieve under cold running water and drain well.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat and cook the chopped onion for about 5 minutes until softened.
Add the quinoa to the pan and stir for 1 minute to coat in the oil.
Pour in the vegetable stock and add the salt, then bring to the boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid and simmer for 15 minutes until the quinoa has absorbed the liquid and is tender.
Remove from the heat and stir through the dried cranberries, then cover and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Fluff the quinoa with a fork, stir through the toasted almonds and season with black pepper before serving.
